PIG1_EPOCH.title: By Scent
PIG1_EPOCH.description:
It only meant to follow a [purple][sine]sweet smell[/sine][/purple] toward the [gold]Spire[/gold].

There was food inside, warm places to sleep, and little shiny things. For a [orange]Pig[/orange], that was already reason enough to keep climbing.
PIG1_EPOCH.unlock:
The [orange]Pig[/orange] lifts its snout and sniffs the air.

There is definitely something good in this tower.
PIG1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Played|Play} a run with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG2_EPOCH.title: Eat First
PIG2_EPOCH.description:
The [orange]Pig[/orange] quickly learns that climbing does not require grand ideals, but it absolutely does require a full belly.

As long as there is flavor on its tongue and warmth in its stomach, it will keep going up and knock aside whatever blocks the path.
PIG2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG3_EPOCH.title: Guarding
PIG3_EPOCH.description:
The Spire's creatures are always trying to take something: food, territory, or a comfortable place to settle.

So the [orange]Pig[/orange] learns to bare its teeth, slam forward, and flip over anyone foolish enough to reach for its bowl.
PIG3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG3_EPOCH.unlockText: Unlocked 3 [orange]Pig[/orange] relics for guarding food and turf.
PIG4_EPOCH.title: Naps
PIG4_EPOCH.description:
The [orange]Pig[/orange] discovers that a proper [green]nap[/green] can make waking courage feel much larger.

So it begins bottling drowsiness, good dreams, and reckless momentum into [purple]potions[/purple], saving them for exactly the right moment to chug.
PIG4_EPOCH.unlock:
The [orange]Pig[/orange] stacks bottles at its feet and gives a satisfied snort.

Now even a nap can be carried along.
PIG4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG5_EPOCH.title: Company
PIG5_EPOCH.description:
One [orange]Pig[/orange] is noisy enough. A whole crowd of pigs turns a fight into a spectacle.

It grows used to making other charges part of its own momentum. More friends mean more nerve, and much more trouble.
PIG5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [purple]Elites[/purple] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG6_EPOCH.title: Shiny
PIG6_EPOCH.description:
Gold glitters, shops beckon, and every shelf seems to hold something that ought to belong to the [orange]Pig[/orange].

It learns to trade spoils for greater spoils, and to turn one shopping trip into an excuse for the next greedy impulse.
PIG6_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Killed|Kill} [blue]15[/blue] [red]Bosses[/red] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
PIG6_EPOCH.unlockText: Unlocked 3 [orange]Pig[/orange] relics tied to gold and shopping.
PIG7_EPOCH.title: Pig King
PIG7_EPOCH.description:
It is still greedy, sleepy, territorial, and helplessly drawn to shiny things.

But now the [orange]Pig[/orange] walks through the whole [gold]Spire[/gold] with its head held high, snorting like a king that truly belongs there.
PIG7_EPOCH.unlockInfo: Beat [red]Ascension[/red] [blue]1[/blue] with the [orange]Pig[/orange]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
